requirements.general: Entry Level and Requirements Foundation: Matriculation or Foundation Certificate with CGPA 2.0 Diploma: A relevant diploma with a CGPA of at least 2.00 from another institution STPM: Grade C+ CGPA 2.33 in 2 subjects and SPM credit in Mathematics and a pass in English A-Level: 2Ds UEC: 5 subjects at grade B including a pass in Mathematics and English SACE: 5 subject with ATAR of 55 NSW (HSC): 10 units with ATAR of 55 CPU: 6 passes with an average of 55 TEE: 4 or 5 subjects with ATAR of 55 Australian Year 12: TER/UAI/ENTER 55 Others: Other equivalent qualifications as recognised by the government of Malaysia
